# dsh-session-intent-title
English | 中文文档
An independent, zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that automatically classifies new con
versation intents and names sessions with clean prefixes (e.g., `⚡ 优化｜...`, `🐛 修复｜...`, `✨ 功能｜...`).
## ✨ Features
- **🎯 Automatic Intent Classification**: Evaluates the first user message using lightweight LLM prom

pts to detect task intent and extract concise subjects.
- **🛡️ Zero UI Invasion**: Pure backend logi
c provider. Does not inject any frontend CSS, sidebar overrides, or custom themes. Perfectly compati

ble with `dsh-better-sidebar` and native DSH Web UI.
- **🔒 Safe & Non-Intrusive**: Only triggers onc
e on the first turn. Any manual renaming by the user immediately locks and will never be overwritten
on the first turn. Any manual renaming by the user immediately locks and will never be overwritten.
